kind: ARCHITECT GO — SINGLE EXECUTION, K1R1 NON-DEGENERATE GRADIENT AMENDMENT
approved_by: Codex architect, after the K1R1 readiness revision of 2026-08-27 and a re-verification against the current filesystem
scope: Execute exactly once the K1R1 amendment: load the EXACT sixteen-tensor module state committed by the K1 leaf, push ONE backward over the preregistered deterministic non-degenerate 8x84 stimulus, measure the twelve amended checks A01-A12, compose the verdict with the immutable K1 evidence, and write only j20_runs/j20_k1r1_nondegenerate_gradient_v26c_2026-08-27_r1.
why_this_amendment_exists: K1 returned FAIL_CLOSED 28/29. Its sole failure, P24, was caused by K1's own stimulus: an all-zero observation batch makes the first-layer weight gradient identically zero, because dL/dW = (dL/dy) x^T. The amendment measures that one quantity under a non-degenerate stimulus and composes it with K1's immutable twenty-eight passing checks.

the_k1_record_is_immutable.rule: the K1 leaf, its receipt, its commit verification, its result, its GO, its preregistration and its runner bytes are READ ONLY. This GO does not authorise editing, re-running or overwriting any of them.
